notes: I revised the multi-token combination rule: for 3+ tokens the tail is the reversed tokens concatenated in reverse token order (`revs[last]+...+revs[1]`), which cleanly matches E12 ("ab cd ef gh"→"ba hgfedc") and E14 ("ab cd ef"→"ba fedc"), and for two tokens both reversed tokens are kept in full (matching most of E20). The messy cases like "one two three"→"eno rhwt" and "red green blue"→"der ulbng
